total_weight_after_reset.meaning: totalWeight after voters call reset in the next epoch's window
total_weight_after_reset.checkpoint: after voters reset, before emission distribution

emission_distributed.meaning: a minted epoch emission was distributed/accounted to the reward flow during the epoch distribution

gauge_claimable_after_distribution.meaning: claimable amount recorded on the gauges after the epoch emission distribution

assumptions: The checked action is the epoch emission distribution (distributeAll/notifyRewardAmount) occurring after voters reset totalWeight to zero.
A minted epoch emission exists to be distributed in the epoch window.

unresolved.description: Report does not state a numeric or relational link between the distribution action and gauges' claimable value; the impact 'claimable == 0' is only an outcome observation, so the required_effect on emission_distributed cannot be tied to the claimable observable without inventing a relation.

limitations: The impact's claimable==0 is recorded as an impact-context observable but the report supplies no relation connecting it to the distribution effect, so the direct P/I/V relation is not fully expressible.
